title: Maps on slices from a constant module are determined by constants
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, Λ a commutative ring, M,N Λ-modules, U an object, and a,b:F(M)|U→F(N)|U maps of underlineΛ|U-module sheaves, where F is [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. If a and b have the same value on η_M(x) at the terminal object U/U for every x in M, then a=b. Evaluation there on η_M gives a Λ-linear map M→P_N(U), where P_N and η_M are as in [lem-sf-constant-module-unit-locally-bijective].

source.place: Tags 03CY and 093T: uniqueness in module sheafification, restricted to slices and evaluated on constants.

proof.text: Evaluate a at U/U and compose with the module unit. Restrict scalars along the ring unit to see that this is a Λ-linear map. For every V→U, naturality of a,b and η_M transports equality at U/U to equality on every constant η_M(x) over V.

For any section s of F(M) over V, local surjectivity of η_M gives a covering image sieve on which s restricts to a constant η_M(x). The equality from the first step and naturality of a,b show their values on s agree after every restriction in that covering sieve. Separatedness of F(N) gives equality on s over V. Componentwise extensionality proves a=b.
